title: Copper Golem Disc
description: Minecraft Live had a lovely soundtrack that I don't think many people are aware of! So I made one of the tracks a music disc.
body:
This resourcepack changes the "Creator (Music Box)" disc to be the song "Copper Golem" by Camilo Forero from the  Minecraft Live: September 2025 Soundtrack.

Of course, due to Minecraft's disc changes, the song has been carefully trimmed to fit the bounding of the "Creator (Music Box)" disc. I may later also upload a version that replaces the regular "Creator" disc if desired.

Here are the links to the original track's album if you so desire to listen to them!

Youtube: [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=T6FFkRIZN10](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=T6FFkRIZN10&list=OLAK5uy_neg7mZkWQ1py43ii0Nwf1KEgegMRAkKgs)

Spotify: https://open.spotify.com/album/0hleQRmiV1yhavxxn6zVyZ
